resources.string: Open the SIMKL developer page in your browser and sign in to SIMKL if asked.
Create a new app. Give it any name (for example “SIMKLr”), pick AUTH V2 and choose the app type “TV, devices & command line”. Leave the other fields as they are and save.
Copy the app’s Client ID. SIMKLr does not need the Client Secret.
Paste the Client ID in SIMKLr and tap Continue.
Tap Sign in with SIMKL. SIMKLr shows a short code.
Tap Open SIMKL, check that the code matches (or type it in) and approve. Come back to SIMKLr: it signs you in by itself.

• “Could not start the login”: check that you copied the whole Client ID, without spaces.
• The code expired: tap Sign in with SIMKL again for a new one.
• The approval page shows an error: edit your app on SIMKL and make sure its type is “TV, devices & command line”.
• Older AUTH V1 apps keep working.
